task: Analytics queries are slowing down the transactional DB. Make sure analytics reads don't go to the write database.

candidate_memories.content: analytics-svc is configured to route all SELECT queries to the read replica via READ_DB_URL; any query hitting the primary is a misconfiguration.
Analytics and reporting workloads must always target the read replica, never the primary; the primary is reserved for transactional writes only.
READ_DB_URL is set per service in vault:/secret/services/{name}/db; verify analytics-svc is reading the correct vault path, not the shared DEFAULT_DB_URL.
The read replica has a replication lag of up to 5 s; analytics queries must tolerate slightly stale data.
candidate_memories.notes: note: replication lag is a trade-off, not the routing fix

candidate_memories.content: Database connection pools should be sized separately for read and write paths to prevent analytics from exhausting write connections.
candidate_memories.notes: note: pool sizing is a related concern, not the primary fix

candidate_memories.content: Primary DB CPU spiked to 95% during the analytics batch run; confirmed due to analytics queries hitting the primary.
